name: IONIC Digital

profile.reading:
This site along FM 516 north of Barstow, in rural Ward County, Texas, began as an undeveloped parcel that Celsius Network's cryptocurrency-mining subsidiary acquired from Core Scientific in September 2023 for $14 million, a purchase that also settled litigation between the two companies. Celsius itself was working through Chapter 11 bankruptcy at the time, following its 2022 collapse as a crypto lending platform; the mining assets and this Ward County land emerged from that bankruptcy process as the seed of a new company, Ionic Digital, formed specifically to hold and operate them.

Construction proceeded in phases of identical 50-megawatt buildings. The first was energized on August 27, 2024, initially housing roughly 15,500 bitcoin-mining machines, with day-to-day mining operations run under a management agreement with Hut 8, a separate, publicly traded mining operator. A second 50-megawatt building came online in October 2024. Ionic Digital's plan called for four such buildings in total, bringing the site to a combined 234 megawatts of power infrastructure -- part of a broader Ionic Digital portfolio that, across all of its Texas sites (including Garden City, Rebel, Stiles, and East Stiles), totaled roughly 318 megawatts under management.

In April 2025, Ionic Digital announced a strategic pivot: rather than running all of that capacity as bitcoin mining indefinitely, it would look to lease site capacity to artificial-intelligence and high-performance-computing customers and redeploy mining hardware elsewhere. That pivot culminated in October 2025, when Ionic Digital signed a ten-year, roughly $2 billion triple-net lease with Nscale for the entire 234-megawatt Cedarvale site, to be built out to host on the order of 104,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs supporting Microsoft's AI infrastructure needs, with room to expand power further over time. Ionic Digital itself went public via a direct listing on Nasdaq in late July 2026, trading at a reported valuation near $2 billion and marketing itself explicitly as a former bitcoin-mining operation pivoting toward AI and HPC infrastructure hosting.

Unlike most facilities in this registry, Cedarvale's history is unusually well documented in public filings and trade press, precisely because of its path through two corporate bankruptcies -- Celsius, and Core Scientific's own 2022-2023 Chapter 11 case -- and a subsequent public stock listing, each of which generated SEC disclosures, court filings, and press coverage that an ordinary privately held data center would not produce. What remains unconfirmed publicly as of this writing is the precise build-out timeline for converting the existing bitcoin-mining infrastructure to AI and HPC hosting, and how much of the original mining hardware has been relocated elsewhere versus retired outright.

reading: Ionic Digital is a publicly traded digital infrastructure and bitcoin mining company that completed a Nasdaq direct listing on July 28, 2026 under ticker IOND, filing with the SEC under CIK 0002007691. The company originated from the bankruptcy estate of Celsius Network, the cryptocurrency lender that collapsed in 2022, with mining assets from that estate reorganized into a standalone operating company. Ahead of its Nasdaq debut, Ionic Digital pivoted its business mix from primarily bitcoin mining toward AI infrastructure, reporting that AI infrastructure revenue had surpassed bitcoin mining revenue and raising approximately 400 million dollars in the process, with trade press estimating the company's valuation at roughly 2 billion dollars around the time of listing. Coverage has also noted friction between company leadership and some shareholders who inherited their stakes through the Celsius creditor distribution process. Ionic Digital's Texas facility recorded in this registry sits within a business that is actively transitioning its technical infrastructure from bitcoin mining hardware toward AI and high performance computing workloads, a shift that makes site-level specifications, such as exact megawatt capacity, likely to change materially in the near term relative to any figure captured at a single point in time.
